shared_elements: bearded male figure in strict profile
standing figure in long belted robe
row/frieze of figures facing the same direction
hand raised holding a bowl or vessel
curled/tiered hairstyle rendered as rows of ringlets
low-relief figures against a plain ground
justification: Both surfaces depict a horizontal frieze of bearded men in strict profile, wearing long belted robes, walking in single file and raising a hand that holds a shallow bowl or vessel, with hair and beards rendered as regular rows of tight curls — a very specific and conventional processional/offering scheme. The main differences are in scale and variety: A shows fewer, larger figures with more differentiation (a prominent figure gesturing, a fringed garment, a lower register with subsidiary detail), while B is a tightly repeated, near-identical file of bearers with no hierarchy or additional accessories.
